note: Original short reflections written for ALEF (Lane 1, 2026-11-04) in the spirit of book/opening-prayer.txt. They are NOT reviewed by clergy, a rabbi or a native Hebrew speaker and are not liturgy. The Hebrew phrase in each card is a verbatim slice of a data/corpus/registry.json entry (referenced by registryId); registry statuses vary (tests/calendar.cards.test.js checks the slice is contained in the entry). Glosses are plain English renderings written for ALEF, not published translations. Card pools are 23 long so a given card does not repeat on the same weekday.

morning.piece: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם
morning.gloss: I give thanks before You, living and enduring King.
morning.text: Before the list begins, one breath of thanks. You woke up, and that is where the day starts.

morning.gloss: How good are your tents, Jacob, your dwellings, Israel.
morning.text: Whatever room you walk into today, notice what is good about it before you notice what is missing.

morning.piece: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
morning.gloss: Eternal One, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
morning.text: You will say some words today that matter. Begin them slowly.

morning.piece: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ
morning.gloss: Grant peace, goodness, blessing, grace, kindness and compassion upon us.
morning.text: You cannot fix everything today. You can add a little peace to one conversation.

morning.piece: אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה
morning.gloss: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit.
morning.text: Before you speak: is it true, is it kind, does it need saying? One honest pause is enough.

morning.piece: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ
morning.gloss: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You.
morning.text: Let what you say and what you think today point in the same direction.

morning.gloss: You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing with favor.
morning.text: Enough is a real amount. Notice one thing today that is already enough.

morning.piece: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם
morning.gloss: Return us to You, Eternal One; renew our days as of old.
morning.text: Starting again is allowed, even in the middle of a week. Especially then.

morning.piece: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ
morning.gloss: Let them praise the name of the Eternal One, for His name alone is exalted.
morning.text: Say one thing out loud today that you usually only think: thank you, I was wrong, I am glad you are here.

morning.gloss: May the Eternal One bless you and keep you.
morning.text: Someone near you needs a blessing and has not asked. Give it quietly, in words or in an act.

morning.gloss: May the Eternal One make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.
morning.text: A face that lights up when you arrive is a gift. Be that face for someone today.

morning.piece: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם
morning.gloss: May the Eternal One lift up His face to you and give you peace.
morning.text: Peace is a practice, not a mood. Do one small thing toward it before noon.

morning.gloss: Hear, O Israel: the Eternal One is our God.
morning.text: Listen first. Finish hearing one person today before you begin your reply.

morning.gloss: Blessed are You, Eternal One, who gives the Torah.
morning.text: Learning is a way of showing up. Ten minutes with these letters counts.

morning.piece: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו
morning.gloss: Magnify the Eternal One with me, and let us exalt His name together.
morning.text: Praise and curiosity are stronger shared. Tell someone what you are learning today.

morning.gloss: God, please heal her, please.
morning.text: The shortest prayer in the Torah is five words (Numbers 12:13). Short is allowed. Is there someone to wish healing for, in five words or fewer?

morning.gloss: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they will praise You always.
morning.text: Some places feel like home when you sit in them. Make one today, even a corner of a table.

morning.piece: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ
morning.gloss: You shall love the Eternal One your God with all your heart and all your soul and all your might.
morning.text: Bring the whole of yourself to one thing today, not the split-screen version.

morning.gloss: Who is like You among the mighty, Eternal One?
morning.text: Wonder is allowed before breakfast. Look at one ordinary thing as if for the first time.

morning.gloss: Blessed be the glory of the Eternal One from its place.
morning.text: Meaning is not always where you expect it. Stay alert for it in the commute, the kitchen, the inbox.

morning.piece: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
morning.gloss: May the One who makes peace in the heights make peace for us.
morning.text: Make room for someone who sees it differently. You can disagree and still make peace.

morning.gloss: The Eternal One gives strength to His people.
morning.text: Strength shared is strength doubled. Borrow a little from someone today, and lend a little back.

morning.gloss: Friends, let us bless.
morning.text: Before you eat today, take one breath of thanks. Then eat.

evening.piece: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ
evening.gloss: Hear, O Israel: the Eternal One is our God.
evening.text: The day is done. What is unfinished can wait. Listen once more, then rest.

evening.piece: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
evening.gloss: Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.
evening.text: Not everything needs a verdict tonight. Let the day be what it was.

evening.piece: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי יְהוָה לִי וְלֹא אִירָא
evening.gloss: And with my spirit, my body: the Eternal One is with me, I will not fear.
evening.text: Fear is loudest at night. Name one worry, put it down, and let it wait until morning.

evening.piece: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה
evening.gloss: Into His hand I entrust my spirit when I sleep and when I wake.
evening.text: Hand the day back. You are allowed to sleep without having solved it.

evening.piece: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
evening.gloss: May the One who makes peace in the heights make peace for us.
evening.text: Name one tension from today. Wish it peace, even if you cannot resolve it.

evening.piece: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ
evening.gloss: Grant peace, goodness, blessing, grace, kindness and compassion upon us.
evening.text: Which small kindness did you receive today? Say thank you to it, silently or aloud.

evening.piece: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם
evening.gloss: Return us to You, Eternal One; renew our days as of old.
evening.text: Where did you drift today? Notice it without scolding yourself. Tomorrow is another chance to come back.

evening.piece: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ
evening.gloss: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You.
evening.text: Look back over your words today. Keep the ones you would say again, and quietly drop the rest.

evening.piece: אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה
evening.gloss: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit.
evening.text: If you spoke too sharply today, decide on the one sentence of repair you will offer tomorrow.

evening.piece: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם
evening.gloss: May the Eternal One lift up His face to you and give you peace.
evening.text: Bless the people in your home, or in your thoughts, tonight, by name.

evening.piece: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
evening.gloss: Eternal One, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
evening.text: What did you learn today, even if it was small? Say it in one sentence.

evening.piece: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן
evening.gloss: You open Your hand and satisfy every living thing with favor.
evening.text: List three things that were enough today.

evening.piece: בָּרְכוּ אֶת יְהוָה הַמְּבֹרָךְ
evening.gloss: Bless the Eternal One, who is blessed.
evening.text: Someone answered you today, in words or in a look. Remember who.

evening.piece: מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
evening.gloss: How good are your tents, Jacob, your dwellings, Israel.
evening.text: Where did you feel at home today? Go back there in your mind for a moment.

evening.piece: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ
evening.gloss: You shall love the Eternal One your God with all your heart and all your soul and all your might.
evening.text: Choose one line from today that you want to remember, and say it once before you sleep.

evening.piece: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּטֶרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא
evening.gloss: Lord of the world, who reigned before any being was created.
evening.text: Before all of this there was quiet. Sit in a little of it before you sleep.

evening.piece: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ
evening.gloss: Let them praise the name of the Eternal One, for His name alone is exalted.
evening.text: Close with praise for something small: a meal, a message, a bus that came on time.

evening.piece: מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהוָה
evening.gloss: Who is like You among the mighty, Eternal One?
evening.text: Honest wonder tonight: what surprised you today?

evening.piece: יְהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן
evening.gloss: The Eternal One gives strength to His people.
evening.text: Strength for tomorrow comes from rest. Let the lights go off.

evening.piece: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ
evening.gloss: May the Eternal One bless you and keep you.
evening.text: Say a quiet blessing for yourself. You did your best with what you had.

evening.piece: אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ
evening.gloss: God, please heal her, please.
evening.text: Is someone you know unwell or struggling? Five words for them tonight, or fewer.

evening.piece: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר
evening.gloss: The Eternal One will reign forever, your God, Zion, from generation to generation.
evening.text: Some things last longer than any one day's worries. Let that be enough for tonight.

evening.piece: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי
evening.gloss: There is none like You among the gods, Eternal One.
evening.text: Gratitude for uniqueness: one person or thing today that nothing else could replace.

fridayEvening.text: The week stops being a to-do list. Light the candles, or simply pause, and let the room change.

fridayEvening.piece: לְכָה דוֹדִי לִקְרַאת כַּלָּה פְּנֵי שַׁבָּת נְקַבְּלָה
fridayEvening.gloss: Come, my beloved, to meet the bride; let us welcome Shabbat.
fridayEvening.text: Welcome Shabbat the way you would welcome a friend you have been waiting for.

fridayEvening.gloss: The children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath.
fridayEvening.text: Shabbat is kept, not just reached. Decide what you will set down until it ends.

fridayEvening.gloss: Remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy.
fridayEvening.text: Remember, then rest. Six days of making, one of being.

saturdayEvening.piece: הִנֵּה אֵל יְשׁוּעָתִי אֶבְטַח וְלֹא אֶפְחָד
saturdayEvening.gloss: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid.
saturdayEvening.text: As Shabbat ends, choose one thing from the rest to carry into the week.

saturdayEvening.piece: הַמַּבְדִּיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחוֹל וּבֵין אוֹר לְחֹשֶׁךְ
saturdayEvening.gloss: ...who separates between holy and ordinary, between light and darkness.
saturdayEvening.text: A difference between rest and work is worth protecting. What will you protect this week?
